messages:
Aisha Bello: putting up a proposal for SLO/alerts around Private upgrade runs (pre-GA). goal is: catch real regressions + customer-impacting stuck upgrades, avoid paging on expected "precheck failed" and operator aborts.

Dashboards draft:
- Grafana "Private Upgrades / Overview" (staging): https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/priv-upgrades/overview?var-env=staging
- "Upgrade Step Timings" (p50/p95 by step): https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/priv-upgrades/step-timings
- "Failures + Rollbacks" panel: https://grafana.redwoodinference.internal/d/priv-upgrades/failures-rollbacks

Metrics (from installer + control plane logs):
- upgrade_runs_total{env,customer_id,from_version,to_version,result}
- upgrade_step_duration_seconds{env,customer_id,step,phase}
- upgrade_step_failures_total{env,customer_id,step,error_class}
- rollback_triggers_total{env,customer_id,reason}

Alert proposals:
1) "Upgrade run failure" (non-precheck)
- condition: sum(rate(upgrade_runs_total{result="failed"}[30m])) > 0 in prod AND result_reason != "precheck" AND result_reason != "operator_abort"
- routing: page oncall only if customer_id != "internal" OR if failures >= 2 in 30m (to avoid one-off).

2) "Rollback triggered"
- condition: increase(rollback_triggers_total[15m]) >= 1 in prod
- routing: ticket by default; page only if reason in {"schema_migration_failed","control_plane_unhealthy","gateway_unavailable"}

3) "Step duration anomaly" (stuck step)
- condition: p95(upgrade_step_duration_seconds{step!="download_bundle"}[30m]) > 2x p95 over previous 7d OR absolute > 20m
- plus a hard stuck detector: max_over_time(upgrade_step_duration_seconds{phase="in_progress"}[30m]) > 30m for any step

4) "Upgrade controller not emitting heartbeats" (control plane side)
- condition: absent_over_time(upgrade_controller_heartbeat{env="prod"}[10m])

Open Qs:
- do we ever want to alert on precheck failures (e.g. sudden spike from a bad installer build)? maybe warning-level only.
- do we gate by rollout stage (beta customers only) to avoid noise as we ramp?

feedback welcome esp on thresholds + paging vs ticket.

Sean Gallagher: this is good. +1 on not paging for precheck failures. those are usually "you don't have snapshot perms" or "disk full" and support/PS can handle.

A couple tweaks:
- the run failure alert should be ratio-based too. otherwise one customer fails 1 run at 2am = page. I’d rather: failures >= 2 OR failure_rate >= 20% over 1h for non-internal.
- step durations: hard absolute thresholds are safer than "2x baseline" for early days. baseline will be noisy while we’re changing steps.

Also, we should explicitly exclude on-prem airgapped "import bundle" steps from duration paging (those can be hours depending on customer process).

Allison Grant: +1. also please separate "installer step duration" (client-side) vs "cluster step duration" (server-side). if laptop sleeps, installer duration looks stuck but cluster may be fine.

Do we have step state in control plane? like step_started/step_finished events w correlation id? if yes, build anomaly based on cluster-side events.

Connor O'Brien: re: operator_abort classification: we can make installer emit result_reason="operator_abort" only for explicit `redwood-private rollback --abort` and not for ctrl-c. ctrl-c is ambiguous. (people ctrl-c when it’s hung).

Maybe set ctrl-c to "unknown" so we still see it, but don’t page unless it spikes.

Also: for beta we’ll have at most 1-2 customers + internal staging. paging on every single failure will be painful.

Rafael Mendes: agree on ticket vs page split.

For paging criteria: I’d page only for "upgrade started" -> "customer gateway down" risk. i.e. any of these should page:
- control plane unhealthy after apply
- gateway readiness gate exceeded
- rollback blocked by forward-only migration (this one is scary)

Otherwise create Jira (INT) + slack notification to #private-upgrades.

Jacob Stein: diagnostics bundle angle: alert should include link to bundle location if present.

Installer emits `diagnostics_bundle_path` in structured logs. Can we surface that as an annotation in Grafana alert? (or at least include correlation_id so incident-bot can fetch the bundle path).

Ethan Park: control plane side: we do have heartbeat + per-step events now (post pr_18544 for correlation id propagation). control plane emits:
- upgrade_step_event{event="started|finished|failed", step, correlation_id}
- upgrade_run_state{state="idle|running|failed|succeeded", correlation_id}

I prefer step anomaly based on control plane events for anything that touches cluster state. installer-only steps can be informational.

Neha Kapoor: +1 to being strict about what pages. also want "change in failure mode" alert (new error_class) as warning.

Something like: count_over_time(upgrade_step_failures_total{error_class!=""}[6h]) by error_class, alert if new error_class appears in prod.

Aisha Bello: all good points.

updated proposal (v2):

A) Paging alerts (prod only, non-internal):
1) "Rollback triggered (high severity reasons)"
- increase(rollback_triggers_total{reason=~"schema_migration_failed|control_plane_unhealthy|gateway_unavailable|rollback_blocked"}[15m]) >= 1
- include labels: customer_id, from_version, to_version, correlation_id

2) "Gateway not ready after upgrade apply" (customer impact proxy)
- upgrade_step_event{step="gateway_rollout",event="started"} without a matching finished within 20m (cluster-side timer)

3) "Upgrade controller heartbeat missing"
- absent_over_time(upgrade_controller_heartbeat{env="prod"}[10m])

B) Ticket / slack-notify alerts:
4) "Upgrade run failed" (excluding precheck + explicit operator abort)
- (increase(upgrade_runs_total{result="failed",result_reason!~"precheck|operator_abort"}[1h]) >= 2) OR (failure_rate >= 20% AND total_runs >= 5)

5) "Step duration anomaly" (cluster-side only, exclude airgap import)
- step exceeded hard threshold:
  - control_plane_apply > 15m
  - db_migration > 20m
  - gateway_rollout > 20m
  - smoke_test > 10m
- plus "2x baseline" as warning-only once we have 2w of data.

6) "Precheck failures spike" (warning only)
- increase(upgrade_runs_total{result="failed",result_reason="precheck"}[6h]) >= 10 AND unique(customer_id) >= 3

C) Nice-to-have:
- "new error_class seen" warning

Action items:
- Aisha: update dashboards + add annotations for correlation_id (and link out to logs search)
- Jacob: check if we can auto-resolve diagnostics_bundle_path from correlation_id in incident-bot
- Connor: align installer result_reason taxonomy (precheck/operator_abort/unknown)

If no objections, I’ll open PR to observability-pack to add these alerts behind feature flag `private_upgrade_alerts_enabled`.

Sean Gallagher: v2 looks right. only tweak: for paging, add ">=1 AND customer_id not empty"; internal prod-like envs sometimes have blank customer_id.

Also, for gateway not ready, consider making it 25m not 20m until we settle on timeouts. false pages are worse.

Allison Grant: +1. and please make every alert include `runbook_url` label so oncall has a single click.

Runbook section for alerts can live at: https://confluence.redwoodinference.internal/display/SRE/Private+Upgrade+Alerts (or whatever Rafael has).

Rafael Mendes: I’ll add a short runbook page + point to existing upgrade runbook sections for triage steps (check step graph, get diagnostics tarball, validate forward-only migrations).

Connor O'Brien: ok on taxonomy changes. I’ll sync w Devon (installer) but should be quick.

Aisha Bello: ack. I’ll set gateway threshold to 25m for now + include runbook_url. PR coming today.
